name: ALEAPP
description: Android Logs, Events and Protobuf Parser
report_description: ALEAPP is an open source project that aims to parse every known Android artifact for the purpose of forensic analysis.
source_hint: A tar, zip or gz archive, a disk image (raw image, E01, AFF, DMG or virtual disk, L01 or AD1), or a folder holding an Android full file system extraction. Several disk images of a RAID set can be picked together.

secrets.title: SIGNAL RECOVERY KEY
secrets.subtitle: The Signal recovery key is optional

fields.name: signal_recovery_key
fields.label: Optional. The account's 64 letters and digits that open a Signal on-device backup.
fields.if_absent: No Signal recovery key: a Signal on-device backup is only listed, its messages and media stay encrypted.
